scope: The authorized target only, rate limited.
enforcement: The exclusion list is merged with the runner's mandatory list at command-build time, so removing it from configuration does not re-enable destructive templates.
severity_mapping: info.severity maps directly onto the lab's five levels.
offline_behaviour: -no-update-templates and -duc are always passed, so a lab run never downloads templates or contacts the update service. Install templates before class if the machines are offline.

install.windows: winget install nuclei  - or download nuclei_Windows_amd64.zip from https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/releases and put nuclei.exe on PATH
